preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.

postconditions.description: The returned string must start with the original string s.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == return_value[-(i+1)] for i in range(len(return_value)//2))
postconditions.description: The returned string must be a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == min(len(p) for p in (s[:i][::-1] + s for i in range(len(s)+1)))
postconditions.description: The returned string must be the shortest palindrome that can be formed by adding characters in front of s.
